lines: Once I defeated the last monster, the scene around me completely changed.
I was in Gosha Academy's underground training room.
It was a training facility with simulations which combined robots with stereoscopic imagery.
I had come here for training all the time this summer, with my Oniwaban, Library.
And on this particular day, I had been summoned here by Nao-senpai, whom I had met for the first time yesterday, to have a mock battle that I didn't want to do.
「Headmistress Asagi doesn't rate you highly for nothing, I see.」
「I made them opponents that a first-year like you probably wouldn't be able to beat.」
However, the opponents that showed up were Yaguruma Yaemon and some salamanders.
Although the former had now broken ties with me, I had known the Nisha leader well for a long time, and had also fought the real thing with Kirara-senpai.
As for the latter, I had heard about their nature and tactics in detail from Hebiko, who had fought them in the Chaos Arena.
And above all, I had been asked by Headmistress Asagi to help with the simulation settings for both of them.
In other words, it was natural for me to win.
Of course, I hadn't told Senpai about that behind-the-scenes situation.
I could have just lost on purpose too, but, perhaps the result of my intensive training with Library, I managed to win somehow or other.
I hesitantly tried to go home, when Nao-senpai snapped,
「Does that mean you're telling me to approve of your ability?」
「Are you saying you're the one who deserves to be the commander of the new squad?」
「No, that's not what I mean. I still don't really understand this nomination for commander of that newly-established unit.」
「I have my hands full just with the Independent Commando Unit right now, so even in the unlikely event that they approached me about that, I think I would decline......」
「Then that would mean you were ceding the commandership to me, wouldn't it? My pride won't allow that.」
Frankly, I was fed up with being forced to accompany Nao-senpai, just because I was a candidate for the commander of some newly-established unit that I didn't even know about.
But despite that, she was such a beauty, after all. In some ways, she had an aura that wouldn't take no for an answer, and in the end, I had even been made to do a mock battle.
「I'll recognize your commanding ability, up to a point. But my real demand is something else.
I had been told that we were testing out whether or not it was righteous for me to be a candidate for the commander of this newly-established squad, but we were clearly changing course.
「Uh, what are you going to make me do next......?」
「I'm going to allow you to join my unit. So you'll have to demonstrate your ability there, now won't you?」
Naturally, I wanted to be excused from that.
「Wait a minute, please! I've got a unit of my own too, so there's no reason for me to do something like―――Ugh!」
Nao-senpai grabbed hold of my necktie and yanked me towards herself.
It was such a short distance that our lips were almost touching.
「Terrible murders are happening in this town. Can you leave them be, knowing that?」
Senpai's breath gently touched my lips. Her nice scent was drifting across as well.
「Uuh...... Even if you tell me something like that all of a sudden......」
She brought her face even closer.
Now at a position where it felt like our lips must already be touching, she whispered,
「Good♪ Then, I'll introduce the members of my squad.」
Senpai suddenly let go of my tie.
Having been practically arching backwards, I came dangerously close to falling on my backside.
She hurried out of the training room.
And I plodded along after her.
Waiting for us in the lobby outside were―――
「Let me introduce you. These are the members of my prized Public Order Unit.」
That was a woman with her right eye covered by her hair, who had a strangely inconspicuous vibe to her, but a conspicuous chest, in spite of that.
「All class representatives are put on the Public Order Unit automatically.」
「You know Hebiko, I see. She is Shishimura Koro. She's also my best friend.」
She was also someone I had never seen before.
Going by the colour of her tie, it looked like she was the same school year as Nao-senpai.
I had thought, “She's a quiet one, huh?”, but could it be that she was saying something?
That thought must have shown on my face, because Nao-senpai explained for me.
「Koro-chan has a small voice, so people mistakenly think she's untalkative.」
「It's just that her voice is a little quiet, right?」
「Ehh? Is that so? Did you hear that, Fuuma-chan?」
「Nope, not a word. Rather, I can't hear her at all.」
Koro-senpai said something to me again.
Going by the movements of her mouth, it looked like she had repeated the same thing, but...
「You're hard of hearing, I see. She said, “I wanted to meet you, since you're famous even in your first year.”」
Nao-senpai interpreted her words, which I couldn't hear at all.
「How is it, Koro-senpai, meeting Fuuma-chan for the first time?」
Nao-senpai and Hebiko could make her out, but I was completely in the dark.
However, from the pair's reactions, I got the feeling that I was being complimented, so I just bowed my head.
For some reason, Koro-senpai was startled, and cast her face downward.
Hebiko nudged me with her elbow.
Koro-senpai was shaking her head slightly.
「You called her by her given name, all of a sudden! She's a female senpai!」
I couldn't hear what she was saying, but she nodded.
Nao-senpai clapped her hands to bring attention to herself.
「Gosha Public Order Unit. Let's start today's investigation!」
「I've allowed you to join my squad. I won't let you get away with being useless to me.」
And so, I got dragged into investigating the serial killing incidents that were occurring in Gosha.
